caption: Save this for later when you need a quick, healthy treat for your kiddo! 🍌✨ No oven. No complicated ingredients. Just a soft, mildly sweet snack your toddler will love 💛 🥣 Ingredients: • 1/2 banana   • 1 egg   • 2 tbsp Greek yogurt   • 2 tbsp flour   • Pinch of baking powder   • Fruit topping of your choice   👩‍🍳 How to make: Mash + mix the wet ingredients, add the dry, and stir well. Pour into a microwave-safe cup or dish, cover with a plate, and microwave for 2 minutes. That’s it!
